divergences.why: today's effective_props.py's _resolve_typed_fields never calls _canonicalize_enum_text for MainScale/PostScale's SheerAxis default (it reads _member_default off the CLI_STYLE-rendered whole-struct text, which never canonicalizes) -- this port fixes it, e.g. DeusEx.DeusExMover.MainScale.SheerAxis. gui-inspector-props-payload-redesign/spec.md §1's Engine.Brush.MainScale worked example.

today's _resolve_typed_fields hardcodes ctx_by_type key "typedprops.ESheerAxis" for MainScale/PostScale's SheerAxis enum; this port resolves the real export's own outer-based identity key, Core.Scale.ESheerAxis -- the SAME key the generic schema walk would give the same real enum. Applies uniformly to every class's MainScale/PostScale (all carry this leaf, Step 8/9).

serve/scene.py's _struct_members_via/_enum_names_via derive a struct/enum member's owning package via prop.owner.split('.', 1)[0], which is wrong whenever the member is reached through a struct (a struct member's owner is the bare, unqualified struct name) -- Core.Scale's own member Scale is exactly this case. This port resolves the owning package via the member type's own export-record outer field instead (uprops.values._pkg_for_owner/resolve_type_export, already bug-free), matching Task 4 Step 5's Rust code.
